date_to_basis: Addis Ababa Agreement, read in full (Peacemaker PDF, 13 pp.). The text prints conclusion on 27 Feb 1972 and fixes ratification (and so entry into force of the Cease-fire Agreement, which ends all military operations) for noon, 12 Mar 1972. It does not record that ratification actually took place, and the registry marks the ratification day CONTESTED (2 Mar per JOHNSON2003 against 12 Mar in this text). Proposed: year 1972 only; month/day VERIFY. HRW1993 not used.
verify: month/day [VERIFY]: 27 Feb 1972 (concluded) vs 12 Mar 1972 (ratification fixed in text, not confirmed as done)

cite.title: Addis Ababa Agreement on the Problem of South Sudan, closing clause
cite.quote: This agreement is hereby concluded on this twenty-seventh day of the month of February in the year one thousand nine hundred and seventy two, A.D, in this city Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, between the Government of the Democratic Republic of the Sudan on the one hand and the Southern Sudan Liberation Movement on the other. It shall come into force on the date and hour fixed for its ratification by the President of the Democratic Republic of the Sudan and the Leader of the Southern Sudan Liberation Movement. It shall be ratified by the said by two Leaders in person or through their respective authorized Representatives, in this city, Addis Ababa Ethiopia, at the twelfth hour at noon, on the twelfth day of the month of March, in the year on thousand nine hundred and seventy two, A.D.

cite.title: Agreement of the Cease-fire in the Southern Region
cite.quote: Article 1. This Agreement shall come into force on the date and time specified for the ratification of the Addis Ababa Agreement. Article 2. There will be an end to all military operations and to all armed actions in the Southern Region from the time of cease-fire.

notes: Quotes verbatim from the PDF text layer, including its typos ('by the said by two Leaders', 'on thousand').
The registry entry says to cite by article because the transcription has no printed page numbers; PDF page numbers from pdftotext are given as well.
No UN Security Council or other UN document was found that prints the date; the UN-hosted agreement text is the source used.
